decision_basis: Compute and published task size only; no BRIDGE test learner requirement label or forecast accuracy was viewed.
reason: The frozen full 108-column transfer requires OEH-B 64 draws for every one of 70 pilot groups. Actual 176-state groups already take 12-17 minutes each, and the 1006-state development one-draw grid takes 288 seconds. The projected full 14-task run exceeds the prespecified 72-hour local compute cap; this is a feasibility estimate, not a measured lower bound on wall time.
continuation: Run the already-defined matched ablation oeh_without_direct_oehb on all 14 BRIDGE test tasks, together with B2 matched. Keep the same pilot, learners, seven-class endpoint, split, metrics and meta-training. OEH-H plus legacy features remain; direct OEH-B law, its concentrations and cross-learner OEH-B context are omitted. Do not describe this as transfer validation of full OEH 108.
prelabel_gate: Seal both B2 and reduced-OEH predictions before any BRIDGE test labels; one unchanged label run only after that seal.
